title: Delinquency Schedule — Late Charge Terms, Courtesy Waivers and Advance Freeze Days for Operating Lines of Credit
content:
The delinquency terms of the Operating Lines of Credit concern interest bills left unpaid after they fall due. They are set product by product.

## Terms

- **Late charge percentage**: the late charge on an interest bill still unpaid after the grace period, as a percentage of the unpaid billed interest.
- **Minimum late charge**: the minimum late charge per late interest bill, in USD.
- **Maximum late charge**: the maximum late charge per late interest bill, in USD.
- **Grace period**: the calendar days after an interest bill's due date before a late charge is assessed.
- **Courtesy waivers**: the late charges that may be waived as a courtesy on one line in any rolling 12-month window.
- **Freeze days**: the calendar days an interest bill may stay unpaid past its due date before advances are frozen.

## Schedule

| Product | Late charge (% of unpaid billed interest) | Minimum (USD) | Maximum (USD) | Grace period (calendar days after due date) | Courtesy waivers per rolling 12 months | Freeze days (calendar days past due date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 5 | 25 | 250 | 15 | 1 | 30 |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | 5 | 25 | 250 | 15 | 1 | 30 |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | 5 | 35 | 500 | 15 | 1 | 45 |
| Revolving Operating Line | 5 | 35 | 750 | 15 | 1 | 30 |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 4 | 50 | 1500 | 10 | 0 | 15 |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 4 | 100 | 2500 | 10 | 0 | 15 |

## Points of reading

- The Borrowing Base Operating Line and the Agribusiness Revolving Line allow no courtesy waiver of a late charge.
- On every product the freeze days run longer than the grace period, so a bill that stays unpaid reaches its grace limit before it reaches the freeze point.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* for a Seasonal Operating Loan bill due on 15 January, the 15-day grace period runs through 30 January and the 45 freeze days run through 1 March of a non-leap year.
